title: Puharich courted by dark occult groups

tellings.quote: tells a story in a lecture much later in his life about how he was always approached by these you know, what he would call kind of dark occult groups

plain: A researcher named Greg, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says that Andrija Puharich, a scientist the episode connects to the CIA, the US intelligence agency, told a story in a lecture late in his life. According to Greg, Puharich said he was always being approached by what he called dark occult groups, secretive circles interested in hidden or magical knowledge. If true, it would mean his work on the mind drew the attention of shadowy outsiders.
